# @stolyarovmn/dsh-client-ui-schedule-tab 0.6.14

Review-only UI fix for the notification settings modal.

## Fixed

- Native DSH Switch controls no longer render outside the visible modal.
- Removed the oversized minimum width from the settings list.
- Preference copy now shrinks before the switch, while the switch remains fixed at the right edge.
- Notification preference behavior from 0.6.13 is unchanged.

No npm publish requested.
